# James Gartshore

> Free, plain-English tech tips on phones, computers, scams and getting online, written for people in Bridlington, Driffield and across the East Riding of Yorkshire. Written by James Gartshore, who lives in Bridlington, England, and volunteers with a local tech support group. The tips are a separate, spare-time project.

- [Get help](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/help/): free UK help lines and services by problem (scams, hands-on tech help, access needs, money, wellbeing).
- [Tech words explained](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/glossary/): plain-English meanings of common tech words.
- [About James Gartshore](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/about/): who writes the tips, and where to find hands-on help.
- [Poster design examples](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/designs/): free posters designed for local people and groups.

## [Scams and staying safe](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/topics/scams-and-staying-safe/)

Free tips to spot, block and report scams by text, phone call, email and online, plus simple ways to keep your phone and computer safe.

- [Get Online Week Day 4](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/get-online-day4/): It's day four of Get Online Week, and today I wanted to talk about passwords, because they're something almost everyone struggles with.
- [Phone Still Safe](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/phone-updates/): I wanted to share a quick check you can do to see if your phone is still safe to use for things like banking and email.
- [Get Online Week Day 3](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/get-online-day3/): It's day three of Get Online Week, and today's tips are about free tools that help you stay safe from scams.
- [Phone Stolen](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/phone-stolen/): I wanted to share what to do if your phone is ever lost or stolen, and a couple of things worth doing now, just in case.
- [Voice Clone Scam](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/scam-voice-clone/): I wanted to share a warning about a scam that's becoming more common: phone calls using a copy of a family member's voice.
- [Fake Parcel Texts](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/fake-parcel-texts/): I wanted to share a warning about fake parcel delivery texts, as they're one of the most common scams around at the moment.
- [Find a Bad App](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/find-bad-app/): Following on from my post about scary pop-up adverts, here's what to do if ads keep appearing on your Android phone even when you're not using any app.
- [Scary Pop-up Ads](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/scary-popup-ads/): I wanted to share a tip about those scary pop-ups that sometimes appear on phones.
- [Computer Safety](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/pc-safety/): I wanted to share a few tips about keeping your computer safe, because a lot of people end up paying for antivirus they don't actually need.
